beur-hagra.1#א: One suspected, etc. Bechorot 30a and other places.
beur-hagra.1#ב: Whether, etc. Chapter 2 of Demai — he said regarding himself, etc.; and there in several places; and Baer Heitev.
beur-hagra.1#ג: And if one dined with him, etc. Chapter 2 of Demai as above. (Lekut) And if one dined with him, etc.; and even though we say in Avodah Zarah 39b, etc., if one dined, etc. — Rashi there s.v. one does not buy, etc., as written in seif 2 (until here).
beur-hagra.1#ד: And some say, etc. Avodah Zarah 39b — baraita: one does not, etc.; and Rambam explained it deals with plain people we do not recognize; he mentioned Syria and all the more outside the Land; excluding Eretz Yisrael when majority of Israel was upon it; and now Eretz Yisrael is like outside the Land for this; and the first reasoning followed Rashi there s.v. one does not buy, etc.; and see seif 2.
beur-hagra.2#_: Transgressing a sin, etc. Taz challenged this (and see below s.k. 18).
beur-hagra.3#א: Since he is not, etc. There: now he steals a theft, etc.
beur-hagra.3#ב: And if, etc. As written above.
beur-hagra.3#ג: Sometimes, etc. As Rashi explained there.
beur-hagra.3#ד: Nevertheless, etc. As written in chapter 3 of Demai regarding deposit, etc.; and Gittin 61b — they grind and deposit, etc.; and there it appears equivalent to giving to prepare as written because he wants to substitute, etc.; and it appears this was before the answer there as the mishnah states the reason, etc.; and one might think they are suspected to steal and substitute; but according to the answer — because he wants specifically when giving to prepare, but regarding deposit the desire does not apply as written, and he returns the items, etc.
beur-hagra.4#א: One suspected, etc. Baer Heitev; ruled like R' Shimon because the Gemara there follows him. (Lekut) One suspected for one matter, etc. — as anonymous mishnah Bechorot 30a: one suspected regarding, etc.; and even though R' Meir disagrees as written — some say Rabba bar bar Chana, etc.; halachah follows the Sages and anonymous mishnah; and Tosafot there 36a s.v. perhaps, etc.; and so we establish in Chullin s.v. let us say supports, etc. (until here).
beur-hagra.4#ב: (Lekut) But everything needed, etc. Like R' Shimon — Rava acted there accordingly (until here).
beur-hagra.5#א: One suspected, etc. Gemara there — why Sabbatical Year, etc.; the whole discussion there.
beur-hagra.5#ב: Unless. There in R' Yehudah's locale, etc.
beur-hagra.7#א: One who, etc. There — not like R' Meir; likewise first chapter of Chullin.
beur-hagra.7#ג: (Lekut) Or does not believe, etc. Like a Samaritan — not only regarding others' property is he not believed, for "before the blind do not place a stumbling block," as first chapter of Chullin (4a) and explicit in Niddah (57a); but even regarding his own it is forbidden, for we establish like R' Eliezer as in Gittin and as above siman 2 seif 9; all the more he is not believed regarding his own because of "before the blind" as above (until here).
beur-hagra.7#ד: And regarding others' property he is believed even regarding that matter to say it is permitted — only regarding prohibition we say so; but regarding monetary matters one suspected regarding one matter is disqualified to testify regarding another even regarding others', as Choshen Mishpat siman 34. And some say here and siman 124 seif 9 the Rav ruled like the Mechaber; Choshen Mishpat 34:205 and Even HaEzer end seif 42 — Rav wrote one suspected regarding sexual immorality is disqualified for testimony about a woman; there the reason is interest in testimony. Difficult: we decide halachah end Yoma and Bechorot 39b like Rashbag against R' Meir; Rashba 64 and Ribash 4 answered anonymous mishnah then dispute; Raavad: Rashbag disputes R' Meir only on blemishes; Demai ch.4 after dark — Yerushalmi Shabbat honor; entering city proves guest leniency; Rambam only when unrecognized; Rashbag believed on another's property; plain person per Rambam not trusted but believed on others unlike suspected; prohibitions even woman and slave believed siman 118:8; Rashba 64, 400; difficult Rama on appetite — see siman 2 s.k. 12.
beur-hagra.7#ה: One who is suspected, etc. As written first chapter Bava Metzia (5b) "do not covet" for people; chapter Zeh Borer Sanhedrin 26b regarding those buried, etc.
beur-hagra.7#ו: However, etc. Since he thinks it permitted — practical difference whether called suspected so believed under oath — suspected not believed as seif 8; as beginning Bava Metzia and "do not covet" — Rama and Shach responsa.
beur-hagra.7#ז: One who practices, etc. As Yevamot 14 — he informed them; chapter 25 (111b) he cares for ancestral seed, etc.
beur-hagra.8#_: One suspected, etc. As Bava Metzia 6a conclusion: presumption suspected for money is suspected for that matter on oath — except old loan doubt; unlike here. Chullin 4: only helps checking knife; Bechorot end accepting fellowship — they did not say oath helps; Rashba 64.
beur-hagra.9#_: Convert, etc. Sanhedrin 61b — one who worships idolatry, etc.; we establish like Rava exempt; Tosafot there; Shabbat 72b Rava; Rambam Sanhedrin 20:2; exempt from lashes as Rambam — "to the girl you shall do nothing" — all coercion from fear of death is coercion as Rambam and Ketubot 3b modest women, etc.; Rava exempt completely and karet as Torat Kohanim that one — not coercion; since court does not punish, not disqualified for testimony Rambam and Shulchan Aruch Choshen Mishpat 34:2; even d'rabbanan disqualification without proclamation as chapter 7 and Gittin 45b convert returned, etc.; as above siman 401 seif 2 and Orach Chaim 39:3.
beur-hagra.10#_: Informer, etc. As above siman 2 seif 9; disqualified for testimony but believed as above.
beur-hagra.11#_: Apostate, etc. As Shach — he acts from love and exempt as seif 9.
beur-hagra.12#_: Forced ones. As seif 9; Ribash 4 and 11.
beur-hagra.13#א: One who sells, etc. It appears the reason he is not in commerce — though if bought surplus he may sell, primary purpose is not trade; and if sold to gentile or dogs as there; see there.
beur-hagra.13#ב: And all benefit-prohibitions, etc. Mishnah there yayin nesech and Gemara there even Rashba what did I lose you; and no law of sale.
beur-hagra.14#א: One who sells, etc. As Yerushalmi chapter 3 Yevamot — R' Yudan asked what proof from their words for tereifah sight, etc.; see siman 39 seif 1–2.
beur-hagra.14#ב: And if he sold from an animal, etc. Meaning seller cannot say bring proof it is tereifah — as muggeret in Bava Kama 99b: since safek tereifah no greater defect — mistaken transaction as if certainly tereifah; unlike animal not checked standing on presumption of permission Chullin 9a; unlike firstborn — Rashi Bechorot s.v. he returns, etc.
beur-hagra.15#_: Without subterfuge. Since lest he deceive, etc.; rather, etc.
beur-hagra.16#א: Butcher whose actions, etc. As first chapter Chullin (18a) that butcher, etc., we remove, etc.; Hagahot ShaDa (93b) and halachah to flog him, etc.
beur-hagra.16#ב: Nevertheless, etc. As muggeret as above.
beur-hagra.17#_: Butcher, etc. Otherwise how disqualify all disqualifications who could say so.
beur-hagra.18#א: Butcher, etc. As Choshen Mishpat 34:24 — but if they saw him, etc.; see there.
beur-hagra.18#ב: And that which he must, etc. As end Bechorot — baraita: one who comes, etc.; need not act like butcher — many are lenient there not wicked intending to mislead unlike here; transgressed and Rashi Gemara 41a and all, etc.
beur-hagra.19#א: (Lekut) From expert so-and-so, etc. Even though sender did not instruct buy only from expert — unlike Raah who said only like mishnah told buy from so-and-so; truth mishnah Bechorot 36b supports; but we do not hold so — rather Rav there: priest believed, etc. (until here).
beur-hagra.19#ב: He brought him a gift, etc. Bechorot 36a — R' Yochanan believed, etc.; see sugya; and Rashba first chapter Chullin.
beur-hagra.19#ג: In what case, etc. As first chapter Chullin (6b); end Nezikin — now he steals a theft, etc.
beur-hagra.19#ד: And all this does not, etc. We only find this in Demai — Beit Yosef; not so — we say chapter Eggs (63b) buying eggs when he says, etc.; even gentile per Rav siman 86 because of exposure; all the more sending where he fears as Bechorot end; certainly supports; we are not concerned to substitute even one suspected d'oraisa Chullin 6a giving to neighbor's wife, etc.; not because of Shevi'it — Tosafot suspected on Shevi'it; see siman 118 seif 8; siman 2 seif 4; Taz and Peri Chadash challenged.
beur-hagra.20#_: One suspected, etc. And some say, etc. Baer Heitev s.k. 28; as chapter 2 Avodah Zarah chavit — Rashi and R' Yehudah explained suspected only substitutes for that matter; Shach.
